plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Nokia ISAM access device. It reports uptime, board CPU utilization, board memory utilization, board temperature, and interface traffic, for Nokia (Alcatel-Lucent) ISAM / 7360 / 7302 access nodes (enterprise PEN 637).
name: Access

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Board CPU load of the Nokia ISAM from ASAM-SYSTEM-MIB cpuLoadAverage (per slot, 0-100 %), shown as the busiest board. A slot is reported only while its CPU-load monitoring is in progress (operateStatus proceeding).

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of all boards of the Nokia ISAM, from ASAM-SYSTEM-MIB totalMemSize (per slot, Mbyte scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of all boards of the Nokia ISAM, from ASAM-SYSTEM-MIB memAbsoluteUsage (per slot, Mbyte scaled to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Board memory utilization of the Nokia ISAM, computed per slot as memAbsoluteUsage / totalMemSize * 100 and shown as the highest board.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Highest board thermal-sensor reading of the Nokia ISAM, from ASAM-EQUIP-MIB eqptBoardThermalSensorActualTemperature, in degrees Celsius. Sensors are reported only for boards that are plugged in and operationally up.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_total_incoming_traffic
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of total bytes received by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from IF-MIB inbound octet counters (prefer 64-bit ifHCInOctets).

metrics.name: device_total_outgoing_traffic
metrics.description: This metric represents the average rate of total bytes sent by the entire device over the past 5 minutes, summed from IF-MIB outbound octet counters (prefer 64-bit ifHCOutOctets).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart, derived from IF-MIB sysUpTime.
